05-13.solution: Rs. \(500\) earns Rs. \(300\) in \(8\) years, so the rate is \(\frac{300 \times 100}{500 \times 8} = 7.5\%\). Rs. \(1200\) must earn Rs. \(1440\): time \(= \frac{1440 \times 100}{1200 \times 7.5} = 16\) years.

05-25.solution: The sum earns \(0.8\) of itself in \(4\) years, so \(0.2\) of itself a year. To become \(2.4\) times it must earn \(1.4\) times itself: \(\frac{1.4}{0.2} = 7\) years.

05-27.solution: The sum earns \(\frac{4}{3}\) of itself in \(8\) years, so \(\frac{1}{6}\) of itself a year. To triple it must earn \(2\) times itself: \(2 \div \frac{1}{6} = 12\) years.

05-28.solution: The interest is \(\frac{9}{4} - 1 = \frac{5}{4}\) of the sum in \(9\) years. Rate \(= \frac{5}{4} \times \frac{100}{9} = \frac{125}{9} = 13\frac{8}{9}\%\).

05-29.solution: Interest of \(4\) times the sum in \(20\) years is \(20\%\) a year. In \(25\) years the interest is \(5\) times the sum, so the amount is \(6\) times: \(m = 6\).

05-30.solution: Rate \(= \frac{750 \times 100}{1000 \times 15} = 5\%\). Rs. \(800\) must earn Rs. \(400\): time \(= \frac{400 \times 100}{800 \times 5} = 10\) years.

05-31.solution: The interest is \(0.5\) of the sum in \(5\) years, so the rate is \(\frac{0.5 \times 100}{5} = 10\%\).

05-32.solution: The sum must earn \(1.8\) times itself at \(18\%\) a year: time \(= \frac{1.8 \times 100}{18} = 10\) years.

05-33.solution: The interest is \(\frac{3}{2}\) of the sum in \(6\) years, so \(\frac{1}{4}\) of it a year. To become \(\frac{7}{2}\) times it must earn \(\frac{5}{2}\) times itself: \(\frac{5}{2} \div \frac{1}{4} = 10\) years.

05-34.solution: Rate \(= \frac{1500 \times 100}{3000 \times 10} = 5\%\). On Rs. \(2000\) for \(8\) years the interest is \(\frac{2000 \times 5 \times 8}{100} = 800\), so the amount is Rs. \(2800\).

05-35.solution: The interest is \(\frac{5}{3}\) of the sum in \(10\) years, so \(\frac{1}{6}\) of it a year. On Rs. \(6000\) for \(4\) years: \(6000 \times \frac{4}{6} = 4000\).
